command.description:
The command as its config spells it: a shell line, or a program and its
arguments.

kind.description: Whether the site gates a write or opens an editor.

label.description: The hook's `name`, when it has one.

moment.description:
The config section that declares it: `waits`, `on.flip`, `on.rm`,
`go` or `add`.

anyOf.description: A command line for the platform shell.
A program and its arguments, run without a shell.

CommandJson.description: A config command in its JSON shape.

SiteKind.description: What a [`Site`] does with its command.

oneOf.description: A command `mt` holds back until the user allows it: a checker or gate.
A program `mt` spawns when the user asks for an editor.

description: The object `mt allow --status --json` prints: whether the repository allows the config's commands, and one entry per site.

$schema.description: The URL of the schema this object conforms to.

allowed.description:
Whether the user allowed every command the config declares for this
repository.

sites.description: Every command the config declares, in declaration order.

title: Mindtape allow status
